mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-quarter contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand that reduces corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS contracts for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing output and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO accelerates above 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and cost-push inflation, which reduces corporate margins and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 6.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 900k signals weakening residential investment and lower construction-related earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls below 900k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI inflation below 1.5% combined with a 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals a disinflationary easing cycle that boosts real growth and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when both CPI < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS declines by >0.05% (t-test p > 0.05).
